notes: Cash-basis (modified cash) school district. Top-level figures are the governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (p4-5): beginning fund balance 3,960,580 recorded as beginning_cash, ending 3,958,482 (cash 3,158,174 + county treasurers 800,308). Interfund loans and operating transfers net to zero in the Total column, so top-level transfers are null. The statement's General Fund column combines the budget-schedule General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (statement GF beginning 2,850,249 = 2,538,686 + 250,549 + 61,014); the General Fund budget schedule alone shows ending 2,741,088. 'Other local receipts' 141,982, 'State receipts' 5,015,285 and 'Other' 19,150 were split using the fund schedules and Statement of Activities (nameplate capacity 299,793 = 292,289 GF + 7,329 Special Building + 175 QCPU; state receipts remainder includes homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate and state aid). 'Student support services' split into General Fund 374,144 and Activities Fund 213,351. Statement 'Operation and maintenance of plant' 739,189 includes Depreciation Fund capital outlay 123,690 net of the 250,000 transfer (2650), left as printed. Hidden transfers in General Fund spending (2650 250,000 to Depreciation; 8000 Nutrition 50,000 and Activities 50,000) are recorded in detail as other financing with the General Fund expenditure total flagged includes other financing. General Fund programs 3400, 3535, 3551 and 6000-series federal programs are counted under Instruction (statement Instruction 6,928,890 = 6,284,261 program lines + 644,629 of these). Detail has no object breakdown for General Fund (Exhibit N not in trimmed PDF), so spending lines are program lines with not itemized. Activities Fund has only a one-line budget schedule (no per-account schedule). Budget amounts at heading level only (e.g., Instruction 5,314,000) are not carried. The EB fund budgeted purchased services 61,460 with no actual. Balance sheet is the government-wide statement of net position (cash basis) from p3. Read pages 1-18 of 18
